title: 第五章 吾皇万岁第六章 前朝后宫
lines: 当暴君徒手搓出一颗柚子大小的铁球，嘴里很有精神的喊着什么炮摆出了蓄力投掷的姿势时，一切简直是一场噩梦。
直面这场噩梦的勇卫营禁军再也绷不住了。
他们之所以还没有崩溃，很大程度是这一切发生的太快，像是做梦一样，没有反应过来。
那不是天子！
而是某种活生生的恐怖！
不是人力可以抵挡的存在！
这支剩余不到六百的禁军失去了控制，他们有的慌忙点炮，有的张弓就射，有的投掷短矛，有的射出弩箭，有的投掷油壶，但更多的是开始溃散，不顾一切的朝后退去，只想离左墟远远的。
然而整个太和丹陛除了金銮殿都被封锁了起来，太和门也已经死死闭上，能退到哪里？
想通过金銮殿逃生？
那就要直面已经狂化和神化的昭明帝左墟！
慌乱射出的炮弹没有准头，根本没有落到左墟身上，至于其他劈头盖脸的投掷，左墟眼皮子都没有动一下，任由它们有些落在自己身上。
箭矢，短矛，投枪，燃烧的油壶。
不管是什么也好。
落在左墟身上的时候，都被那天子严格命令过的肌肉直接弹开，即便是猛火油点燃的烈火，在他的身上熊熊燃烧，却不见伤其分毫！
天子的权力是无限的。
区区命令肌肉而已！
反倒是沐浴在烈火中的帝皇，如同被增添了一幅火红金黄的大氅，大氅随风飘舞！他冰冷无情的巡视着他的帝国，凝视着那些胆敢谋害天子的不臣贼子！
对于凡人来说。
受命于天这四个字这一刻具象化了。
钢甲神雷炮出手！
空气中骤然传来了锉刀刮头盖骨的奇特声响，神雷炮化作黑影呼啸而过！
太和丹陛全长也就五百米左右，溃退的禁军距离左墟则更短，这更短的距离，面对亚音速起手的钢甲神雷炮是什么样的结果呢？
答案是：惨不忍睹！
那手搓自整套具装铁甲的铁球破空轰来，未至先有呼啸狂风压身！
撞上密集禁军的瞬间，人马、甲胄、长枪一齐炸开，铁屑与碎骨飞溅。
不是击穿，是瞬间爆碎！骨骼肌肉盔甲一同被爆碎！野蛮凶残的在成群的禁军中凿出了一条血腥值拉满的死亡通道！
不仅是直接命中者惨死。
神雷炮凿出来的死亡通道周围三米之内的倒霉鬼被冲击波直接震死！十米之内的人则是肺腑被猛地碾了一遍，当即受了程度不一的内伤！
而余势未减的神雷炮凿穿了溃散的禁军后，直接轰入了太和城楼的城墙之中。
这座厚十米的城墙砖石与夯土轰然炸开，烟尘冲天！
在猛烈的震颤中似乎摇摇欲坠！
待城楼稳定下来后，城墙上赫然出现了一个放射状的大坑，那颗炮弹深深嵌入其中两米多深，静静的躺在那里，上面似乎还有一个浅浅的手印。
和炮弹的安静对比。
则是勇卫营的鬼哭狼嚎。
这支禁军彻底崩溃了，他们不顾一切的退缩到甬道中，丢掉了无用的武器，拼了命的拍打着城门，希望能够立刻逃离这个人间炼狱！
甬道外，左墟的身影浮现。
content_en:
When the tyrant rolled out an iron ball the size of a grapefruit with his bare hands, yelled about a cannon in a spirited manner and got into a charged-throwing posture, everything was like a nightmare.
Facing this nightmare, the Yongwei Camp Imperial Army could no longer hold back.
The reason why they haven't collapsed yet is largely because it all happened too fast, like a dream, and they didn't react.
That is not the emperor!
But some kind of living terror!
There is no existence that human beings can resist!
This imperial army with less than 600 people left lost control. Some of them hurriedly fired their cannons, some opened their bows and fired, some threw short spears, some shot crossbows, and some threw oil cans. But more of them began to break up and retreated desperately, just wanting to stay away from Zuoxu.
However, the entire Taihe Danbi except for the Jinluan Palace has been sealed off, and the Taihe Gate has been tightly closed. Where can I retreat to?
Want to escape through the Golden Palace?
Then we have to face the mad and deified Zhaoming Emperor Zuoxu!
The cannonballs fired in a panic were not accurate and did not land on Zuo Xu at all. As for the other direct hits, Zuo Xu did not even move his eyelids and allowed some of them to fall on him.
Arrows, spears, throwing spears, burning oil cans.
Whatever it is.
When it fell on Zuo Xu, it was bounced away by the muscles that Tianzi had strictly ordered. Even if the fire ignited by the fierce fire oil burned fiercely on his body, it did not hurt him at all!
The emperor's power is unlimited.
It's just a command to the muscles!
On the contrary, the emperor, bathed in the fire, seemed to be adorned with a fiery red and golden cloak, which was fluttering in the wind! He patrolled his empire coldly and ruthlessly, staring at those disloyal traitors who dared to murder the emperor!
For mere mortals.
The four words "mandated by heaven" became concrete at this moment.
The steel-armored thunder cannon takes action!
Suddenly there was the strange sound of a file scraping the skull in the air, and the divine thunder cannon turned into a black shadow and roared past!
The total length of Taihe Danbi is only about 500 meters, and the distance between the retreating Imperial Army and Zuoxu is even shorter. With this shorter distance, what will be the result when faced with the subsonic steel-armored thunder cannon?
The answer is: terrible!
The iron ball that was rolled out of the entire suit of iron armor blasted through the air, and before it could reach it, it was hit by the roaring wind!
The moment they collided with the dense imperial army, the men, horses, armors, and spears all exploded, and iron filings and bone fragments flew into the air.
It's not a breakdown, it's an instant explosion! The skeletal, muscle and armor were shattered together! Brutally and brutally, he carved out a bloody death passage among the hordes of forbidden troops!
Not only those who were directly hit died tragically.
The unlucky ghosts within three meters of the death tunnel carved out by the divine thunder cannon were directly killed by the shock wave! Those within ten meters had their lungs crushed and immediately suffered varying degrees of internal injuries!
The remaining power of the divine thunder cannon penetrated the defeated imperial army, and then blasted directly into the wall of Taihe Tower.
The masonry and rammed earth of this ten-meter-thick city wall exploded, sending smoke and dust into the sky!
It seemed to be tottering in the violent tremors!
After the city tower stabilized, a large radial crater suddenly appeared on the city wall. The cannonball was embedded more than two meters deep in it. It lay there quietly, and there seemed to be a shallow handprint on it.
Contrast that with the quietness of a cannonball.
It was the howling of ghosts and wolves from the Yongwei camp.
This forbidden army completely collapsed. They retreated into the corridor desperately, threw away their useless weapons, and beat the city gate desperately, hoping to escape from this hell on earth immediately!
Outside the corridor, Zuo Xu's figure appeared.
